metadata_candidate.name: De Woordenaar
metadata_candidate.short_description: Learn Dutch vocabulary with flashcards and spaced repetition
metadata_candidate.full_description:
Build your Dutch vocabulary with De Woordenaar.

Organize words into personal collections and practice with flashcard reviews. Use available word details and examples to support your learning, and keep track of your review progress.

Review previously synchronized cards offline. When you reconnect, synchronize your progress across your signed-in devices. An account and an internet connection are required for initial setup and synchronization. Online features depend on service availability.

This internal test focuses on synchronization reliability, offline review recovery and navigation through large word collections. Features available in the app can depend on the current configuration.
metadata_candidate.release_notes:
Improved synchronization when words are deleted or an authentication session changes.
Improved offline review recovery and navigation through large word collections.
